title: Fann Wong & Christopher Lee receive award at son's school for being parent volunteers

 Fann Wong & Christopher Lee receive award at son's school for being parent volunteers
 Their 12-year-old son attends Maha Bodhi School. 
 Khine Zin Htet 
 November 19, 2026, 04:42 PM
Photos from xiaohongshu_2468
 Celebrity couple Fann Wong and Christopher Lee were spotted receiving an award for being parent volunteers at their son's school. 
 A fellow parent posted on Xiaohongshu on Nov. 19, saying she spotted the two while attending her daughter's primary one awards ceremony. 
 The user commended the two in her post as well. 
 Wong and Lee's 12-year-old son, Zed, attends Maha Bodhi School. 
 Tokens of appreciation
 The Xiaohongshu post also featured two photos of the couple receiving tokens of appreciation. 
 The school's website lists Wong as a member of the executive committee of its parent support group. 
 Wong had previously shared glimpses of her involvement in her son's school. 
 In 2025, for instance, she posted a photo of herself alongside posters she had designed for Teachers' Day. 
 "Pouring my heart into these illustrations was a small way to say a giant thank you to the amazing educators who shape our children every day," she wrote.
